column1: # The divergence.broiler-js fields corpus revision 20 retires: every Unicode vector Broiler.JS matches after
# milestone SJL-7.5's cut-over, under UTC (Broiler.JS/CHANGELOG.md lists the corrections), under the reason
# scripts/conformance/unicode-divergences.txt gave it at revision 19. Broiler.VM had none. The reasons' text

# js-p1-loose-names: row P1: Broiler.JS resolves the names of \p{...} loosely, ignoring their case, underscores, spaces and hyphens, so it admits names ECMA-262's tables do not hold; its cut-over to Broiler.Unicode's exact lookup (milestone SJL-7.5) corrects it
# js-p2-hrkt: row P2: Broiler.JS refuses the Script value Hrkt (Katakana_Or_Hiragana), which PropertyValueAliases.txt and ECMA-262's table hold and which names an empty set; SJL-7.5 corrects it
# js-s2-string-properties: row S2: Broiler.JS resolves the names of the properties of strings loosely, as row P1 does for the other properties; SJL-7.5 corrects it

# js-i1-pattern-syntax: row I1: Broiler.JS's IdentifierStartChar and IdentifierPartChar admit U+2E2F, which is Lm and Pattern_Syntax, and ID_Start and ID_Continue subtract Pattern_Syntax (UAX #31); SJL-7.5 corrects it

# js-i3-group-names: row I3: Broiler.JS's group names copy the identifier tests without Pattern_Syntax's subtraction and without Unicode 17's tables, so they admit U+2E2F and refuse U+11B60; SJL-7.5 corrects it
# js-w1-u0085: row W1: U+0085 is Cc and in neither WhiteSpace nor LineTerminator, and Broiler.JS's scanner and RegExp.escape treat it as white space; SJL-7.5 corrects it
# js-c1-other-lowercase: row C1: U+00AA and U+00BA are Cased (Other_Lowercase), so a final sigma after them is final, and Broiler.JS reads Cased as General_Category Lu, Ll or Lt; SJL-7.5 corrects it

# js-c3-beria-erfe: row C3: Broiler.JS's default mappings are the runtime's data with hand patches, which lack Unicode 17's Beria Erfe case pairs (U+16EA0 to U+16EB8 and U+16EBB to U+16ED3); data policy under decision SJL-D-6 (c), corrected by SJL-7.5

# js-c4-turkic-table: row C4: Broiler.JS's Turkic lower-case path maps every other code point with the runtime's ToLowerInvariant and skips the class's table, so the runtime's older data shows; SJL-7.5 corrects it
# js-c5-soft-dotted: row C5: Broiler.JS's hand-written Soft_Dotted set lacks U+1DF1A, U+1E04C, U+1E04D and U+1E068, which PropList.txt lists; SJL-7.5 corrects it

# js-c6-context-marks: row C6: More_Above and the other casing contexts admit no intervening character of combining class 0 or 230, and Broiler.JS's IsContextTransparent passes over every mark not of class 230, U+0903 (class 0) included; SJL-7.5 corrects it
# js-c7-locale-list: row C7: ECMA-402's TransformCase canonicalizes the list of locales and takes its first element, and Broiler.JS hands the joined list to CultureInfo; SJL-7.5 corrects it
# js-c8-locale-null: row C8: CanonicalizeLocaleList(null) throws a TypeError, and Broiler.JS reads null as the host culture; SJL-7.5 corrects it

# js-n1-lone-surrogate: row N1: normalize and localeCompare normalize the string's code points, and a lone surrogate is one, of class 0, without a decomposition; Broiler.JS's host normalizer throws on it; SJL-7.5 corrects it

# js-n2-host-data: row N2: Broiler.JS normalizes with the host's ICU, which carries Unicode 15.1, and the corpus reads the pinned 17.0.0 (decision SJL-D-6 (c)); every such vector holds a code point Unicode 16 or 17 adds; SJL-7.5 corrects it
# js-g1-sentences: row G1: Broiler.JS answers a text as one sentence, and UAX #29's sentence rules break it; SJL-7.5 corrects it

# js-g2-words: row G2: Broiler.JS's word boundaries are not UAX #29's (a word is not broken at an apostrophe, an underscore, a full stop between letters or a comma between digits, and each ideograph is a word); SJL-7.5 corrects it

# js-g2-g4-word-status: rows G2 and G4: Broiler.JS's word segments are not UAX #29's (row G2), and with them each segment's isWordLike, which is implementation-defined (row G4) and which the vector's broiler-js expectation reads as the owner's word status; SJL-7.5 corrects it
# js-g3-graphemes: row G3: Broiler.JS's grapheme clusters follow the runtime's data, older than the pinned 17.0.0 (decision SJL-D-6 (c)); SJL-7.5 corrects it
